subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona TTS SecretRefs become startup-fatal under the current universal active-ref contract, or should this PR wait for the optional-TTS degradation path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265?
rationale: This fix activates previously ignored credential paths, and current startup policy makes any missing active value fatal; choosing the intended availability behavior is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Sequence with optional TTS degradation
options.body: Repair this branch, then land it with or after the narrow optional-TTS startup behavior so missing persona credentials cannot take down unrelated Gateway capabilities.

options.title: Keep current fail-fast behavior
options.body: Land the repaired collector under the existing activation contract after explicitly accepting and documenting that missing persona TTS refs can block startup.

options.title: Pause persona activation
options.body: Keep this PR open until the broader TTS secrets availability direction is resolved and tested together.

recommendation.title: Sequence with optional TTS degradation
recommendation.body: Repair this branch, then land it with or after the narrow optional-TTS startup behavior so missing persona credentials cannot take down unrelated Gateway capabilities.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the shared secrets activation contract and command/runtime target ownership associated with their prior SecretRef work.
